summary: Backend-only testing for EtherLens AI. All 15 pytest tests passed (100% success) covering: health, interfaces, capture start/stop/clear/status, packets list and detail (with Frame/Ethernet/IP/TCP layers + hex), timeline, top-talkers, topology, threats (SYN-flood detected within 60s), WebSocket /api/ws delivering stats messages, SSE /api/ai/explain streaming delta chunks and [DONE], and PCAP upload (5-packet scapy pcap parsed).

minor.issue: stats_task is referenced in finally even when WebSocketDisconnect occurs before its assignment; could raise UnboundLocalError on very early disconnect. Non-blocking during normal use.
Model id string 'gpt-5.4' is unusual. Streaming currently works and produces deltas, but confirm this is the intended model (gpt-5 variant).

action_items: Optional: initialize stats_task = None before try/except in ws_endpoint to avoid UnboundLocalError risk.
Optional: verify intended OpenAI model id in /api/ai/explain (currently 'gpt-5.4').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ws_endpoint: stats_task defined inside try; finally references it unconditionally.
engine.py simulator loop uses while self.running with inner for-loops; cancellation handled via CancelledError, OK.
list_packets excludes layers+hex (good for payload size); list_threats returns deque reversed to list - OK.
No MongoDB usage currently; mongo client opened but unused - acceptable for scaffold.
seed_data_creation: None required. Simulator generates traffic; PCAP generated in-test via scapy wrpcap.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py uses pytest-xdist (configured in /app/backend/pytest.ini) and runs full flow sequentially via file-scoped loadscope. SSE and WS tests require websocket-client (installed). Simulator takes ~5-45s to inject SYN-flood anomaly; test waits up to 60s.
